ja.title: CHiPS のレシピを当てた上に足す(例: お礼を言われたときだけツンデレ)
ja.text: CHiPS(ヘッドの射影)のレシピを先に当てた状態で、ニューロンを作る例です。fish の iv は空にしてあるので、画面の「先に当てておくレシピ(iv)」に、保存してある CHiPS のレシピの名前を入れてください(入力欄の JSON の fish.iv に書いてもかまいません)。方向・ニューロンの表・鍵・確かめ・返事は、すべてそのレシピを当てた状態で行います。できた FiSH のユニットは、レシピのタブで CHiPS のレシピと同じレシピに並べて使い、「LoRA・焼き込み」から 1 つの LoRA に書き出せます(焼き込みは不可)。対照集合の中身は「特定の場面の返事の口調を変える」と同じです。強さは区切りごとに 1 / 1 / 0.8、層は続いた層(Qwen3.5-4B では 11-23)を勧めます(「特定の場面の返事の口調を変える」の説明を見てください)。試した範囲: Qwen3.5-4B(Q8_0)で 1 回。試したときの形は、層 11,18,23・強さは一律 0.9 です。先に当てたのは、動作を見るために手元で作った小さな proj のレシピ(ヘッド 2 本)です。流れは最後まで通り、式どおりかも合格。足した量は狙う場面で 0.8〜1.0、変えたくない場面で 0.05 以下。作成に使っていない 12 問で、当てないときと同じ程度にツンデレらしい返事が出ました(その「当てないとき」の形は、あとで 100 問で測ると、ツンデレらしい返事 27〜29%・繰り返しに落ちた返事 6〜10% でした。12 問の確かめは甘く出ます。層 11-23・強さ 1 / 1 / 0.8 では 53% でしたが、CHiPS のレシピを当てた上では確かめていません)。実際の CHiPS のレシピと組み合わせたときの良し悪しは確かめていません。 返事は数問〜12 問を読んだだけなので、1〜2 問の差は誤差です。ほかのモデルでは確かめていません。

en.title: On top of a CHiPS recipe (example: tsundere only when thanked)
en.text: An example that builds the neurons with a CHiPS (head projection) recipe applied first. fish.iv is left empty: enter the name of your saved CHiPS recipe in "Recipe applied first (iv)" (or write it in fish.iv in the JSON). The direction, the neuron table, the keys, the checks and the replies are all done with that recipe applied. Put the resulting FiSH units in the same recipe as the CHiPS units in the recipe tab; "LoRA / bake" exports them as one LoRA (baking is not available). The contrast set is the same as "Change the tone of replies in one scene". Strength 1 / 1 / 0.8 per segment and consecutive layers (11-23 on Qwen3.5-4B) are recommended (see the description of "Change the tone of replies in one scene"). Tried on: Qwen3.5-4B (Q8_0), one run, with layers 11,18,23 and strength 0.9 everywhere. The recipe applied first was a small proj recipe (2 heads) made locally just to exercise the flow. The whole flow ran and the formula check passed. The amounts written were 0.8–1.0 in the target scene and at most 0.05 in the scenes to leave alone. On 12 questions not used for building, tsundere-like replies appeared about as often as without the recipe (that setup without the recipe, measured later on 100 questions, gave 27–29% tsundere-like replies and 6–10% replies that fall into repetition; a 12-question check comes out too favorable. Layers 11-23 with strength 1 / 1 / 0.8 gave 53%, but that was not checked on top of a CHiPS recipe). How it works together with a real CHiPS recipe was not checked. Only a handful to 12 replies were read, so a difference of one or two means nothing. Not checked on other models.
